title: CmdPal: Add a Charts and visuals sample page and author docs

proposed_comments.title: Link the authoring guide

confidence.rationale: The exact README line is non-clickable inline code with Windows separators, and the repository-relative link target exists at the pinned head.

proposed_comments.body:
### Link directly to the authoring guide
**Severity:** low

The Windows-style path is inline code rather than a clickable link, and its backslashes are awkward to follow from this README. Link to the tracked guide with a repository-relative Markdown link so readers can open it directly.

```suggestion
Extension authors: see [charts-and-visuals.md](../ExtensionTemplate/TemplateCmdPalExtension/.github/skills/add-adaptive-card-form/references/charts-and-visuals.md), and the Samples extension's "Charts and visuals" page.
```

proposed_comments.title: Clarify host-specific card properties

confidence.rationale: The docs and renderer directly establish that these non-schema properties are read from AdditionalProperties and applied only by the Command Palette polyfill.

proposed_comments.body:
### Clarify host-specific card properties
**Severity:** low

The portability sentence follows the `roundedCorners` and `showBorder` properties but says the card renders the same way in other hosts. These two properties are Command Palette-specific extensions read from `AdditionalProperties`, not schema-defined Adaptive Card properties, so other hosts may ignore them.

```suggestion
The elements follow the [Adaptive Cards schema](https://adaptivecards.microsoft.com/). Command Palette renders schema-defined properties with the schema's defaults, and also supports the Command Palette-specific `roundedCorners` and `showBorder` extensions on containers, column sets, and columns; other hosts may ignore these extensions. Older versions of Command Palette, and hosts without chart support, drop unknown elements. **Always set a `fallback`**: `"drop"`, or a simpler element such as a `TextBlock` with the value.
```
